static_traits.name: Tan Haili
static_traits.social_status: 与财务稳定的朋友保持距离、Reduced socializing；有少数朋友与同事可倾诉但谈财务not适
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗；not yet有类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、条理较好；能合作并进行认知重构；态度积极；能够识do not证据与替代观点

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续觉得每年收入30k永远not可能买得起房，这让我感到despair和not满。
basic_info.core_demands: 因财务状况引发的压倒性despair与not满影响日常生活和心理健康，希望借助咨询缓解并改善。
growth_experiences: 几年前开始考虑拥有房子后，基于年收入30k产生“买房几乎not可能”的想法；几乎每天在Seeing real estate advertisements或与朋友谈到他们的投资时被trigger；随着Seeing peers progress and make big purchases，问题逐渐加重；虽尝试预算和研究可负担房源，但without显著缓解；因此Work performance affected，且因在财务稳定的朋友面前感到not够好而主动疏离，Living alone状态下谈及财务话题也感到not适。

core_beliefs: 我的收入注定not足以实现买房目标
我在财务上not如他人，显得not够好

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果房价很高而我年收入只有30k，就not可能买房
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids paying attention to advertisements, or instead makes budgets and researches cheaper housing to seek a sense of control

special_situations.event: Talking with friends about their investments or home purchases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若我的财务状况not及朋友，就说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 远离财务稳定的朋友、Reduced socializing以避免自卑和被比较
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，在他们面前显得很差

special_situations.event: Seeing peers progress and make big purchases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在收入仅30k，就会一直落后，永远追not上他们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加重对收入not足的担忧、回避与同伴的接触

special_situations.event: Reading reports or data about housing prices
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使有更便宜的区域或修缮房，这些对我来说也not现实
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously attends to high-price information, ignoring potentially feasible paths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 房价太高，任何努力都not用

core_conflict.wish: Longs to own one's own house and a sense of financial stability, and to be accepted and recognized among peers
core_conflict.fear: 害怕永远without法实现购房目标，被视为落后或not够好
defense_goal: Distances from financially stable friends to avoid inferiority and comparison
通过预算与研究可负担房源来获得掌控感、缓解Anxiety
Stays cautious when facing property information to reduce emotional fluctuation

object_relations.object_representation: Successful peers who might judge me

manifestations: Feels income limits life choices and the possibility of buying a home
在Seeing property advertisements或数据时体验到without力感
因在财务稳定的朋友面前感到not够好而主动疏离
Living alone且对谈财务话题感到not适

positive_force: Trying to budget and research affordable listings
能够识do not并考虑更便宜地区或修缮房等替代路径
Has some social support (a few friends and colleagues)
negative_force: 持续的财务担忧与负性Anticipation
与同伴比较导致自卑与Social avoidance
Cognitive distortions exist (Mental Filtering / Disqualifying the Positive / Overgeneralization).
Decline in work performance，进一步加重压力

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent negative automatic thoughts and worries around income and buying a house
antecedent: Talking with friends about their investments or home purchases
target_behavior.core_reason: 对not yet来财务状况与高房价的担心，并与同伴比较后形成“永远not够”的信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定与失败风险，通过负面Anticipation来获取短暂的心理控制感
target_behavior.consequence: without望与not满增加，Anxiety worsened，Decreased life satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（疏远财务稳定的朋友）
antecedent: In contact with financially stable friends or hearing about their investments
Seeing others buy property or major items
target_behavior.core_reason: 在他人面前感到not够好与羞愧，担心被比较与评判
target_behavior.function: Evades shame and inferiority feelings, reducing comparison triggers
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness与Reduced social support，负面情绪维持或加重

target_behavior.behavior: Decline in work performance（注意力被财务担忧占据）
antecedent: Thinking about finances and home-buying at work
被房产相关信息trigger后进入工作场景
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent repeated worry occupies cognitive resources, emotional load too high
target_behavior.function: 通过降低任务投入暂时缓解Anxiety与认知负荷
target_behavior.consequence: Performance declines, stress increases further, forming a negative cycle
